Vacuum and Trash shulker boxes, updated for **Minecraft 26.3** (Paper, Java 25).

- **Shulker Box of Vacuum** (any shulker box + hopper): off-hand stores blocks you mine; main hand stores items you pick up. A full box hands extras to your inventory.
- **Shulker Box of Trash** (any shulker box + lava bucket): off-hand deletes blocks you mine; main hand deletes items you pick up.
- Any colour of shulker box works, and crafting keeps its colour and contents.
- Shulker boxes are never stored or deleted, and breaking chests or other containers is left alone.
- Custom 3D textures for both boxes via the included resource pack (`ShulkerVaccuum-pack.zip`); see the README for the `server.properties` lines.
- Boxes from version 1 keep working and pick up the new look automatically.

Paper 26.3 is still an experimental build, so this release is marked beta. Test on a copy of your world first.
